answer: Transactions & Dealings >> Inheritance & Will Question ID: 20695 Country: India Title: We are two brothers and six sisters, i have my father money, how can we much divide this money? Question: We are two brothers and six sisters, i have my father money, how can we much divide this money? Answer ID: 20695 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 485/410/B=1431) As per Islamic teaching this amount shall be divided into ten shares; out of which 2-2 shares will go to the two brothers and 1-1 shares to the six sisters. This division is valid when there is no other heir except those mentioned above and provided your father is already dead. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
